note: FirstBank's Individual Checking page for the Virgin Islands (its legal notes for the USVI and the BVI): a monthly service fee of 7.50 dollars where the average daily balance falls below 1,000 dollars, and none for customers 65 and older. The waiver for accounts opened from 6 July to 31 December 2026 isn't written.

sources.title: FirstBank Virgin Islands, Individual Checking Account
sources.said: LEGAL BVI ... If a minimum average daily balance of $1,000 is not maintained throughout the cycle, a $7.50 monthly service fee will apply. There is no monthly service fee for customers 65 years and older.
